home_seo_title: Menzies Medora na mboka | Misala ya lopitalo ya kimia mpo na ekipi nyonso ya bobateli
home_seo_description: Medora ezali EMR ya ba lopitalo ebele mpo na bokomisi nkombo, botali, mosala ya kliniki, inventaire, mpe bopesi. Console moko ya Soft Wash mpo na bankolo, basali, mpe ba planchers ya soins.
home_hero_headline: Bobongola mikolo ya lopitalo na koleka ya kimia, ya boyokani
home_hero_body: Medora: ba opérations ya soins ya ba lopitalo ebele na enregistrement, visites, ba bancs de travail clinique, mpe inventaire na console moko ya ba locataires.
home_how_heading: Kobanda na kokomisa nkombo tii na botali ya kokangama
home_how_lead: Flux moko pona walk-ins na soins réservés. Etongami mpo na ba moments ba équipes e déplacer vraiment ba malades.
home_how_step1_body: Bokanga identité, allergie, mpe histoire mbala moko. Visite nyonso oyo elandi esalelaka lisusu etanda yango.
home_how_step2_body: Bosala ba visites ya OP to IP, bokanga ba rendez-vous, pe bomba contexte ya filiale polele pona étage.
home_how_step3_body: Ba vitals ya infirmier, ba diagnostics, ba commandes ya kisi, mpe mikanda e vivre na temps ya visite moko.
home_how_step4_body: Makambo ya inventaire, kopesa ba factures, mpe ba étapes ya décharge etikalaka na boyokani na dossier ya visite.
home_modules_heading: Etongamaki mpo na mokolo mobimba ya lopitalo
home_modules_lead: Ba paquets ya capacité ezo couvrir ba bureaux oyo esengeli ezala en synchronisation: bureau ya liboso, ba étages cliniques, ba magasins, na admin.

pricing_who_lead: Plateforme, lopitalo, basali, mpe bato ya maladi mokomoko azwaka nzela ya polele. Pona Cloud to On-premise, sima niveau moko oyo ekokani na combien de lopitalo na ba modules ozali ko diriger.
pricing_who_platform_body: Ba opérateurs oyo ba semence ba lopitalo ebele pe baza na besoin ya white-label plus SSO. Pona Plateforme na Cloud to On-premise.
pricing_who_hospital_body: Bakolo mpe bakambi oyo bazali kobongisa ba filiales, ba magasins, accès ya basali, mpe ba maîtres. Business to Scale ekokani na ba groupes mingi ya ba sites ebele.
pricing_who_staff_body: Ba infirmiers, minganga, mpe ba équipes ya magasins na ba modules oyo bayebi rôle. Ba limite ya bakiti échelle na plan; ba malades bamonaka jamais bureau ya sima.
pricing_who_patients_body: Ba tableaux, ba visites, mpe mikanda etikalaka na lopitalo. Basali basalaka uta na console na ngambo ya bokomisi nkombo na nzela ya bokangami.
pricing_faq_q1: Ezali prix na visite moko to par siège ya staff?
pricing_faq_a1: Ba niveaux oyo ebimisami ezali na groupe ya lopitalo moko na moko na ba bouchons ya lopitalo mpe ya bakiti. Cloud mpe On-premise bakabolaka Starter, Business, Échelle, mpe Plateforme. Liste ya sanza na esika ezali Cloud + $150. Mode moko te esalelaka métre ya visite moko oyo emati na mikolo ya mosala mingi.
pricing_faq_a2: Facturation annuelle ekangami na mbula moko prévisible ya Soft Wash Medora. SaaS ya lopitalo ya lolenge ya Loomline mbala mingi ekitisaka ba plans ya mbula na mbula soki 15 kino 20%. Medora esalelaka 20% ya liste ya sanza tango ofuti mbula na mbula, mpo na Cloud mpe On-premise (nsima ya +$150 ya prime On-premise).
pricing_faq_q3: Ba modules ya inventaire na clinique ezali na kati?
pricing_faq_a3: Starter ezali na enregistrement ya moboko, ba visites, mpe ba banc de travail clinique na inventaire ya base. Business mpe likolo ko débloquer ba flux ya mosala ya inventaire mobimba, ba commandes ya kisi lié na stock, mpe configuration ya admin riche. Tuna ntango nini ozali na mposa ya ba add-ons réglementés.
pricing_faq_q4: Ba prix ya mokili mobimba vs Myanmar?
pricing_faq_a4: Salelá toggle ya zando likoló ya ba plans. Global elakisaka USD kaka. Myanmar elakisaka MMK na 1 USD = 5000 MMK (na USD lokola ligne secondaire). Période ya facturation na mode ya service ekabwani na marché.
pricing_faq_a5: Cloud ezali hébergé Soft Wash Medora: SaaS ya ba lopitalo ebele, ba mises à jour oyo ekambami, mpe kobanda noki. On-premise esalela ba niveaux moko, installé na infrastructure na yo tango ozali na besoin ya contrôle to résidence. Infra ezali ya yo; liste ya sanza ezali Cloud + $150 mpo na mokumba wana.
